descriptionChirho: To stretch out or extend the hand, whether in healing, action, command, or seizing, across all tenses and moods (Matt 8:3; 12:13,49; 14:31; 26:51; Mark 1:41; 3:5; Luke 5:13; 6:10; 22:53; John 21:18; Acts 4:30; 26:1)
To lay out or let down equipment from a ship, specifically lowering anchors in a nautical context (Acts 27:30)
